field: Financial market infrastructure, central bank digital currency systems, and computational assurance methods
jurisdiction_basis: The present study makes no country-specific legal determination and uses no recruited participants or institution-restricted transaction data. It evaluates a general CBDC assurance architecture with formal models, a local prototype, synthetic data, a public OFAC sanctions-list snapshot, and queueing simulation. Any future governed institutional or field study must resolve its own jurisdiction, data authority, and ethics basis before execution.
reporting_guidelines: Domain-appropriate simulation, model-validation, and reproducibility reporting
